### Day 288: Acts 25:13–22
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-288-acts-25-1322.html
Passage: Acts 25:13-22
Points:
- Paul's continued imprisonment opened an unexpected door to present the gospel before King Agrippa and Bernice.
- Governor Festus was at a loss trying to comprehend Paul’s claim that a crucified Jesus is alive.
- Authentic Christian faith goes beyond vague spiritual opinions to personal, experiential knowledge of the living Lord.
- Believers know Christ because they see His work, feel His presence, and witness answered prayers.
- Dead religious figures cannot deliver, heal, or speak through Scripture with living power today.
